# MoCHII He I 2^3S metastable (triplet) diagnostic coefficients.
# Closed-form rate fits + VFKY96 photoionization cross section for the
# 2^3S balance (Oklopcic & Hirata 2018, ApJ 855 L11 = OH18):
#   n_3 = [alpha_3 ne n_HeII + q_13 ne n_HeI]
#       / [A_31 + Phi_3 + ne (q_31a + q_31b) + n_HI Q_31]
# Transcribed from the EXHALE triplet implementation
#   (EXHALE/src/modules/radiation/Cool_coeff.f90, util_ion_eq.f90;
#    functions/cross_sec.f90::sigma_HeI23S).  Fortran evaluates the
#   closed forms; this file is the auditable coefficient source.
# generated by tools/fitting/make_hei_metastable.py
#
# Provenance:
#  alpha_3, alpha_1 : OH18 recombination into 2^3S / 1^1S systems.
#  q_13, q_31a, q_31b : Bray et al. (2000) collision strengths via
#     OH18 / Lampon et al. (2020); q_31a = 2^3S->2^1S, q_31b = 2^3S->2^1P
#     (spin-changing e-impact into the singlets, NOT 2^3S->1^1S).
#  A_31 = 1.272e-4 s^-1 (2^3S->1^1S, lifetime ~7870 s).  PITFALL: the
#     CHIANTI he_1.wgfa A(1-2)=1.73e-4 is ~36%% high; do NOT use it.
#  Q_31 : Penning + associative ionization He(2^3S)+H0, Taylor et al.
#     (2025, ApJ 989 68) Table 2 (MB-averaged Morgner & Niehaus 1979 +
#     Cohen & Lane 1971).  Two-branch power law, DISCONTINUOUS at 4000 K
#     (jump ~1.6e-9 -> 2.5e-9).  ALTERNATIVE (recorded, not used):
#     Garcia Munoz (2025, A&A 698 A199) k = 1e-9 exp(c + d1 lnT +
#     d2 lnT^2 + d3 lnT^3), c=-8.64804e1 d1=-2.86766e-1 d2=8.68445e-2
#     d3=-5.73001e-3; Taylor is 1.2-2.2x above GM25 over 300-1e4 K -
#     the documented systematic uncertainty of the n_HI Q_31 sink.
#  sigma_3(E) : He 2^3S photoionization, two VFKY96 wings + a log-linear
#     bridge; ~4%% fit to Norcross (1971) + TOPbase (EXHALE sigma_HeI23S);
#     threshold 4.78 eV.  Cross-checked vs p-winds (same Norcross data).
#  q_10830 : 2^3S->2^3P collisional excitation (Stage 2 emission source,
#     recorded only; Black 1981 form).
#  LINE10830 : 2^3S->2^3P_{0,1,2} fine-structure line constants for the
#     10830 A line-center absorption opacity (Stage 2).  Vacuum
#     wavelength [A], oscillator strength f, Einstein A [s^-1].  NIST
#     ASD (Drake 2007) values, via p-winds (p_winds/lines.py).  A-value
#     RESOLUTION: NIST/p-winds give A=1.0216e7 s^-1 for each component; the
#     CHIANTI he_1.wgfa ~1.15e7 (~13%% high) is NOT used.  All three
#     components share A (f split 1:3:5 by g_u cancels g_l/g_u in A_ul).
#     J'=1,2 (10833.217, 10833.306) blend (0.089 A << Doppler ~0.4 A at
#     1e4 K) = the observed 'doublet'; J'=0 (10832.057) is resolved.
#
# Keyword formats (T in K, kT = KB_EV*T in eV, rates cm^3 s^-1):
#  TRANGE  Tmin Tmax          - clamp range for rate evaluation
#  A31     value              - s^-1
#  ALPHA3/ALPHA1  C p         - alpha = C (T/1e4)^p
#  QEXC13/QEXC31A/QEXC31B  prefac sconst Eexc div a b c d
#     q = prefac sqrt(sconst/kT) exp(-Eexc/kT) (a exp(bT)+c exp(dT))/div
#  PENNING Tsplit A_lo p_lo A_hi p_hi
#     Q = A_lo (300/T)^p_lo (T<=Tsplit) else A_hi (300/T)^p_hi
#  SIGMA3A/SIGMA3B  E_th E_0 s_0 y_a P y_w y_0 y_1   (VFKY96; s_0 in Mb)
#  SIGBRIDGE  E3 E4          - bridge boundaries [eV] (log-linear join)
#  Q10830  A E0              - q = A sqrt(T) exp(-E0/T)  (Stage 2)
#  LINE10830  lambda_vac_A f A   - 10830 fine-structure component
#     (one line for each 2^3P_J component; kappa_0 = sqrt(pi) e^2/(m_e c)
#      f (lambda/b) n_3, b = sqrt(2 k T_e/m_He + v_turb^2))
#
TRANGE      1.000000e+02   3.000000e+04
A31         1.272000e-04
ALPHA3      2.100000e-13  -7.780000e-01
ALPHA1      1.540000e-13  -4.860000e-01
QEXC13      2.100000e-08   1.360000e+01   1.981000e+01   1.000000e+00   6.703000e-02  -2.673000e-06  -3.584000e-02  -3.880000e-04
QEXC31A     2.100000e-08   1.360000e+01   8.000000e-01   3.000000e+00   2.847000e+00  -1.252000e-05  -1.953000e+00  -3.558000e-04
QEXC31B     2.100000e-08   1.360000e+01   1.400000e+00   3.000000e+00   1.185000e+00  -4.749000e-06  -9.131000e-01  -1.669000e-04
PENNING     4.000000e+03   1.900000e-09   7.000000e-02   9.100000e-09   5.000000e-01
SIGMA3A     4.780000e+00   2.645000e+00   2.080000e+01   1.000000e+12   3.420000e+00   2.681000e+00   1.956000e+00   2.603000e+00
SIGMA3B     4.559000e+01   4.968000e+01   1.052000e+03   4.393000e-02   2.941000e+00   1.717000e+00   5.488000e-05   1.118000e+00
SIGBRIDGE   3.469642e+01   4.559248e+01
